bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'STARTLESS_PREDEPLOY_AUDIT\n'
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CONTAINER_RUNNING='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'RUNNING_IMAGE='; docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'EXPECTED_TAG_IMAGE='; docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-split-tags-e776
printf 'LOCAL_TAG_IMAGE='; docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'PREEXISTING_POST_COUNTS\n'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'MENU='||count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id>0; SELECT 'TOPIC='||count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id>0; SELECT 'BOARD='||count(*) FROM topic_board_posts WHERE state='published' AND message_id>0; SELECT 'PROFILE='||count(*) FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0; SELECT 'MENU_TOPIC_BOARD_OVERLAP='||count(*) FROM (SELECT chat_id,message_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE state='published' AND message_id>0 UNION ALL SELECT chat_id,message_id FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE state='published' AND message_id>0 UNION ALL SELECT chat_id,message_id FROM topic_board_posts WHERE state='published' AND message_id>0) x GROUP BY chat_id,message_id HAVING count(*)>1;" 
printf 'GATE_ROUTING_PRESENT='; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -lc 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && echo YES'
printf 'SOURCE_DIFF_COUNT='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
